/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/private/tmp/bookmark-export-check.hIlD24')
for filename, expected_name in [('dom-export.csv', 'expected.json'), ('dom-after-add.csv', 'expected-added.json')]:
    raw = (root / filename).read_bytes()
    assert raw.startswith(b'\\xef\\xbb\\xbf'), 'UTF-8 BOM'
    text = raw.decode('utf-8-sig')
    assert text.startswith('\"标题\",\"网址\",\"分类\",\"备注\"\\r\\n'), 'four Chinese column headers with CRLF'
    assert text.endswith('\\r\\n'), 'final record uses CRLF'
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=''), strict=True))
    fixtures = json.loads((root / expected_name).read_text())
    expected = [['标题', '网址', '分类', '备注']] + [[item.get(key, '') for key in ('title', 'url', 'category', 'note')] for item in fixtures]
    assert rows == expected, f'{filename}: every field round-trips exactly'
    assert all(len(row) == 4 for row in rows)
    print(f'PASS: {filename}: BOM, CRLF, four columns, {len(fixtures)} records; Chinese, emoji, commas, quotes, LF/CRLF/CR, blank notes, spaces and trailing newlines retained exactly.')
PY"
